nurse.text: Welcome to the Cardiff Sanctuary. We have a roof. Today, that's the main selling point. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: In a jiffy. Sit by the radiator, you look like you've walked over a mountain.
All better! Don't be a stranger, and do watch the puddle by the door.
The Ark terminal's just here. It runs on tea and optimism.

else.text: Right you are. Shout if anyone needs a plaster.
